name: FckSignups
description: A list of tools that are open-source, in-browser, and require no-signups!
one_liner: A free, browsable directory website listing handy online tools you can use instantly in your browser without creating an account.
buyer: Honestly, nobody is buying this directly — it's a free community resource for privacy-conscious internet users, not something with a paying customer on its own.
business_use_cases: A privacy-focused blogger links to it as a resource in a 'tools I actually use' post to drive newsletter signups, but that's marketing for them, not for this project.
A small business owner bookmarks the site to find a free tool for a one-off task (e.g. converting a file) instead of paying for a SaaS subscription.
It's mostly useful as inspiration: someone studies which listed tools get the most clicks to spot an underserved niche worth building a paid version of.

money_ideas.idea: The site itself could run non-intrusive ads or a 'submit your tool, get featured' paid placement, but that conflicts with its own no-tracking philosophy and would alienate its audience.

steal_this: Skip building anything from this repo directly — instead, browse its list, find the most-requested category with the weakest existing free tool, and build a better paid version of that.
